selection_protocol: Selected strictly via Stratified 5-Fold Cross-Validation on X_train before touching test set

Logistic Regression.description: Linear probabilistic classifier using logistic sigmoid mapping and L2 regularization.

K-Nearest Neighbors.description: Non-parametric instance-based classifier assigning class by majority vote of nearest neighbors.

Decision Tree.description: Rule-based hierarchical classifier recursively partitioning feature space.

Random Forest.description: Bagging ensemble of de-correlated decision trees with randomized feature subsets.

Support Vector Machine.description: Maximum-margin classifier projecting features into Hilbert space via Radial Basis Function (RBF).

Gradient Boosting.description: Sequential boosting ensemble iteratively fitting decision trees to negative gradient residuals.

Neural Network (MLP).description: Multi-layer feed-forward artificial neural network trained via Adam backpropagation.
